title: A Riccati Approach to Mixed $H_2/H_\infty$ Closed-Loop Games for Infinite-Dimensional Stochastic Systems
summary: This paper studies a finite-horizon mixed $H_2/H_\infty$ feedback Nash game for stochastic evolution equations on a separable Hilbert space. The drift generator is unbounded, the remaining coefficients are bounded, and the one-dimensional Brownian diffusion depends on the state, control, and disturbance. The $H_2$ channel is an LQ state--control energy. For the disturbance channel, the stochastic LQ uniform-convexity characterization yields equivalence between strict induced $L^2$ attenuation and unique strongly regular mild Riccati solvability.
